High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.377/2023 registered at Police Station - Madan Mahal, District Jabalpur for offences punishable under Sections 420,406,34 of IPC and section 66 of I.T. Act.
Applicant is in detention since 06.08.2024.

Applicant's first application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 4.08.2025 passed in M.Cr.C.No.32126/25.
2.

As per the prosecution story Mahesh Kemtani submitted a written complaint application and lodge a report in Madan Mahal police station that he wanted to take the franchise of KFC, regarding which he found a post on Instagram on June 12 in which a post was made to give franchise in the name of Devyani International.

After replying to it, he got the mobile number 918274845358 through which he talked to Devyani International's Senior 2 MCRC-9214-2026 Franchise Manager Dr. Nishant Bakshi and Senior Relationship Manager Anurag Agarwal.
Also, he was provided with an e-mail ID.
Which all the conversations and correspondence took place.
On 28 June 2023, he received an email from 10801/10801.75 in which the conditions related to the franchise etc. were explained and information was sought from him to complete the general formalities.
In response to which, he provided the information on the above mentioned mail ID on 30 June.
On 6July, he received an email on the above mentioned mail ID.
He was asked to deposit Rs. 1180000 as franchise fee in HDFC Bank account number 50100632918952.

It is alleged that the applicant/accused in collusion with co-accused has committed fraud in the name of getting franchise of KFC and received the sum of Rs. 11, 80,000/-, Rs. 35,00,000/-, totaling Rs.
46,80,000/- in the bank account of the applicant and other co-accused.
F.I.R was registered.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the role of the applicant is to the extent that he has received Rs.11,80,000/- in his bank account and he has not played any active participation in any of the fraud, as alleged, in the F.I.R.

He has further submitted that applicant is resident of Bihar Deepak Kumar Ray vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 31 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25623820/
1 and he will face the difficulty.

entities.text: Bihar Deepak Kumar Ray vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On last occasion, the court has indicated that whether applicant is ready to deposit the amount of 11,80,000/-.

Learned counsel, upon instructions from the applicant,
submitted that he is not in a position to deposit such amount and, therefore, he prays that considering the role of the applicant that he has received only Rs.11,80,000/- in his bank account and no other allegation is made against 3 MCRC-9214-2026 the applicant, he may be released on bail.
4. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the same by saying that applicant has received the amount of Rs.11,80,000/- in his bank account and the total amount of fraud is Rs.46,80,000/-.
He has further submitted that he is resident of Bihar and there is all possibility that he may not cooperate in the proceeding of the trial.
He has further submitted that looking to the role attributed to the present applicant, no relief should be granted in favour of the applicant.
5. I have considered the rival submissions made by the parties.
I have also considered the material available on the record.

6. From the record, it transpires that the amount of Rs.11,80,000/- is transferred in account of the applicant and looking to the total amount of the fraud Rs.46,80,000, it seems that all the accused persons have joined hands with each other and considering the role of the applicant, I am of the view that no discretion should be exercised in favour of the present applicant.
Therefore,

considering the seriousness of the offence and the role played by the present applicant and also considering the aspect that he is resident of Bihar and there is all possibility that he may not available for the proceeding of trial, I am of the opinion, at this stage, discretion should not be exercised in favour of the applicant.
Application is dismissed accordingly.

(SANDEEP N. BHATT) JUDGE MKL Deepak Kumar Ray vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 31 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25623820/
